summary: Our project consist on a short video demonstrating the whole process of the mission that was developed in order to get the Opportunity Rover to Mars. The focus of the video is to demonstrate the challenges of being in mars, what the objective was, how it was developed and to make the viewer understand the importance of the mission and why the equipment was left behind.
details: Our project is a short video, we used several tools to make it, but mainly blender to animate and davinci resolve to edit the video. The main benefits are that its entretaining and people would want to watch it, so more people can learn about the forgotten equipment left on mars. The impact is to make people understand and comprehend what is the value of sending expensive projects to other planets and abandoning them to never be recovered. Our project was made from basic ideas that all the members of the team contributed and we developed a vision the we would follow to reach our goal. Our team considered all of our opions and the limitations that were presented to make a realistic expectation of what would be shown on the video.
